# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: Well, well, they ran away!
Those who fight only for money never had true courage to begin with!
They were pretty strong, too.
Yet they know no other way to live than groveling before people with money...
Does that mean strength alone cannot necessarily bring $$自由$$?
Perhaps...
that simply is not true strength...
People with no confidence in their own strength always try to rely on something—might, money, or power...
and in the end, that takes away their own $$自由$$.
I don't have confidence in myself either... So what exactly is $$自由$$?
Well, I guess it means...
being able to do what you want and live as you please, right?!
The very idea that $$自由$$ truly exists in $$この世$$...
is utterly mistaken!!
W-what?!
You gutter rats, full of hypocrisy and believing in $$邪教の教え$$!!
Where in $$この世$$ is there anyone who does only what they want...
and only what they like?!
You black $$羽$$ people were never born $$奴隷$$s like us white $$羽$$ people!
Isn't that what $$自由$$ is?!
Ha ha ha ha... I see. You envied that.
What?!
Then all the more so, what you seek will never be yours!
You white $$羽$$ will do nothing but struggle as $$奴隷$$s for all your lives!!
So you are this city's $$領主$$, $$強欲$$'s $$マモン$$...?!
If I kill you, the $$教皇庁$$ will pay me an even more enormous sum.
Now, $$兵士達$$! Earn the money I paid you!!
So money itself is a demon that forever bewilders the human heart...?!
